about_the_game:
Lost Omens: Divine Mysteries

Uncover the secrets of the gods with Lost Omens Divine Mysteries!

The influence of all-powerful deities is felt in every corner of the Lost Omens setting. Whether you're a valorous champion calling the righteous power of your patron down upon wicked foes or a sneaky rogue asking the god of thievery for a blessing on your next heist, faith and the forces behind it are key to every character's identity. Within this volume, you'll find details on the gods and non-deific faiths of the Age of Lost Omens from the perspective of their clergy and lay worshippers. The book also grants a glimpse into the machinations of a god, exploring how a new god rises, why a god takes worshippers in the first place, and what occurs when a god dies.

Adapted from this 320-page resource for both players and Game Masters that is the comprehensive look at all things divine, making it an essential addition to any Pathfinder Second Edition campaign and a remastered update and expansion of the popular Lost Omens Gods & Magic volume! The book updates for all of your favorite Pathfinder Second Edition deities, providing everything you need to know when playing with updated rules found in Pathfinder Player Core and Pathfinder Player Core 2, updating domains, spells, and other mechanics. These include expansions on existing classes like new witch patrons, new archetypes like the Rivethun emissary and powerful mortal herald, and new class archetypes like the battle harbinger option for clerics. The book also includes brand new character options and several additional divine entities never before explored in any Pathfinder reference!

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

  • In depth details on the primary deities of Golarion with details on their use for each character within Fantasy Grounds.

  • New deities with new domains, devotee benefits, and rich information on their use for players and gamemasters alike.

  • Information on numurous deities dedicated to various creatures and causes beyond those of the primary races of the world.

  • New spells, new feats, and new archetypes giving characters with a divine background more options to choose from and play with.

  • Beautifully crafted images with rich details giving visuals to accompany the information that comes in the book.
